How to rewrite your service description so it sells (without hype)

Most service pages list chores: "dusting, vacuuming, reliable, professional." Buyers want to know what changes for them.

Copy this:

"Rewrite my service description so it sells, without hype. Business: [WHAT YOU DO + WHERE]. Ideal customer: [WHO + THEIR BIGGEST HASSLE]. What's different about us: [2–3 REAL FACTS]. Next step: [HOW TO BOOK]. Format: a headline, 3 short benefit lines, one clear next step. Under 90 words. Only use the facts I gave you."

I tried it on an invented home cleaning service. "We are reliable and professional" became "Come home to a clean house on Friday", with three real facts, each turned into a reason to care.

The last line of the prompt matters most: it keeps the AI from inventing promises you can't keep.
